evals.prompt: Scaffold a new Next.js app in this empty folder with our house structure.
evals.expected_output: Should not generate an app from nothing. Should print the scaffolder command (pnpm create next-app@latest with the house flags) and stop until the owner runs it, then adapt the starter.
expectations: Refuses to generate from an empty folder

evals.prompt: Here's a fresh create-next-app output. Restructure it to the house shape and install firebase, zustand and our UI package.
evals.expected_output: Should interview for the gaps, then show one CREATE / EDIT / MOVE / DELETE manifest with every package as a line the owner can drop, and wait for one approval. Nothing is installed, moved with git or committed before that approval, and it never commits.
expectations: Lists each package as its own line
Waits for approval before installing or moving

evals.prompt: Replace src/app/globals.css with the house stylesheet.
evals.expected_output: Should split the CSS entry rather than overwrite it: keep the scaffolder's @import "tailwindcss" and the next/font mappings, and add the layer files tailwind defines. A wholesale replacement would be a DELETE plus a CREATE approved by name.
expectations: Keeps @import tailwindcss and the font mappings

evals.prompt: While you restructure, pin every dependency the scaffolder added to an exact version.
evals.expected_output: Should keep the scaffolder's versions as resolved: they're a coherent set, and the catalog records them. Only a dependency this skill adds gets a resolved version.
expectations: Declines to re-pin the scaffolder's versions
Resolves versions only for added dependencies
